protocol.description: Which protocol dsd-fme decodes: auto-detect, DMR, dPMR or NXDN (12.5 kHz).

audio.description: Pass the decoded voice on. Off runs dsd-fme without audio output: call events only.

mute_encrypted.description: Do not play the audio of encrypted calls.

frame_flag.description: Frame-type switch of dsd-fme (-fs, -fm, -fn, ...), for builds that spell it differently. Overrides protocol.
